channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Australia to begin gun buyback scheme in response to Bondi shooting
item.description: Australia will begin buying back guns in November, almost a year after a shooting at Sydney's Bondi killed 15 people.

item.title: Israel strikes south Lebanon again as families flee north
item.description: Israeli airstrikes hit the Nabatieh district of southern Lebanon just hours after the deadliest day of Israeli raids.

item.title: Yemeni government forces hit back after new Houthi offensive
item.description: Yemeni government forces, backed by Saudi Arabia, have struck back after a new Houthi offensive in areas it controls.

item.title: Who killed Tupac? What to know about the trial of Duane ‘Keffe D’ Davis
item.description: Three decades after rapper Tupac Shakur's death, a former California gang boss is the first person to be prosecuted.

item.title: Iran war live: Talks on Hormuz Strait continue; Israel kills 11 in Lebanon
item.description: Israel kills 11 in deadliest attacks on Lebanon since June truce as Iran and Oman continue talks on Hormuz.

item.title: Yemen’s government says Houthi strikes hit residential areas in Marib
item.description: Yemen's Ministry of Information denounces attacks on Marib as 'escalation' that threatens lives and increases suffering.

item.title: Qatar denies Tehran’s claim it is detaining Iranian bomber pilots
item.description: Iran claims Qatar is holding three pilots who were shot down in March. Doha decries 'misleading statements'.

item.title: Three killed as Russia launches fresh aerial attacks across Ukraine
item.description: Firefighters are tackling a fire at a market in Kyiv, while Moscow reports that a warehouse was hit.

item.title: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
item.description: Hundreds of homes and public buildings have been severely damaged with at least 51 people killed.

item.title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway
item.description: Dozens more are seriously injured after the tourist bus overturned in the early hours of Sunday morning.
